descriptor: Cosy gardening game about snails and patience

voice.summary: Small Fences writes like the back of a lovingly drawn game box: warm, tiny, a bit silly. It celebrates slow growth and snails, with a pixelated wink and zero pressure.
dos: Use soft, small nouns: snail, sprout, fence
Keep sentences in lower-key present tense
Add one tiny joke per paragraph
donts: Do not use gamer jargon like 'grind' or 'meta'

taglines: A garden at your own pace
Out this spring on Switch and PC
boilerplate: Small Fences is a cosy pixel-art gardening game about patience, snails and very small fences, coming this spring to Nintendo Switch and PC.
